categories.title: Floo Flame
categories.info: Floo Flames are Fast Travel points, accessible from anywhere on the map.

categories.title: Conjuration
categories.info: Conjurations are decorations for the Room of Requirements. They are found in hexagonal Collection Chests.

categories.title: Demiguise Statue
categories.info: After completing The Caretaker's Lunar Lament, you can collect Demiguise Moons by approaching the statues at night. Trade theses statues in to the Caretaker to upgrade the Alohomora Spell.

categories.title: Field Guide Page
categories.info: Field Guide Pages are hidden everywhere. Collecting one grants 80 XP and adds it to the collection log.

categories.title: Moth
categories.info: Moths appear once their corresponding Lumos Portrait has been activated. Bring the moth back to the portrait to acquire the Field Guide Page.

categories.title: Wand Handle
categories.info: Wand Handles are decorations for your character's wand. They are found in cylindrical Collection Chests.

categories.title: Chest
categories.info: Chests can contain a variety of items, such as galleons, Wiggenweld potions or gear. Large and Locked chests always contain gear. Contents are randomized from player to player.

categories.title: Daedalian Key
categories.info: Follow the Daedalian Key to its associated House Cabinet to open it.

categories.title: Eye Chest
categories.info: Eye Chests can be opened after learning the Disillusionment Charm; approach the chest without being seen to open it.

categories.title: House Token
categories.info: After starting The Daedalian Keys, follow each Daedalian Key to its cabinet. Open it to obtain a House Coin for your House Chest.

categories.title: Legendary Chest
categories.info: Legendary Chests contain a legendary piece of gear, scaled to your level.

categories.title: Arithmancy Door
categories.info: To open Arithmancy Doors, roll both tokens until they have the indicated animal. The door should open when you try to open it.

categories.title: Lock
categories.info: Locks are unlocked with the Alohomora spell, acquired after The Caretaker's Lunar Lament. Level II and III locks require completion of The Man Behind the Moons.
